title: City Council — 08-04-2020 CH CC Work Session and Business Meeting Minutes-APPROVED.pdf

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to adjourn the Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Petersen

MOTION: Council Member Scott Bracken moved to approve Resolution 2020-36 approving entry into a Federal Aid Agreement for a parking facility on Wasatch Boulevard and 7650 South. The motion was seconded by Council Member Petersen
MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to approve the consent calendar. The motion was seconded by Council Member Petersen
MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to adjourn the Business Meeting and move into Closed Session to discuss pending litigation. The motion was seconded by Council Member Mikell
